sideBetTooltip.pp: Perfect Pairs: pays if your first two cards are a pair
sideBetTooltip.t3: Poker Hand Bet: pays if your first two cards + dealer upcard form a poker hand

soft17Tooltip: H17=dealer hits soft 17 / S17=dealer stands on soft 17

status.ddTooltip: Double Down: bet doubled, one card drawn
status.bjTooltip: BlackJack: Ace and a 10-value card on first two cards
status.surTooltip: Surrender: forfeit hand and reclaim half the bet

tutorial.betControls: Set your bet amount here. Adjust the slider to choose how much to wager.
tutorial.betButton: Once you've set your bet, press this button to start the game.
tutorial.dealerHand: Both of the dealer's cards are face up from the deal, so you can read the total before deciding.
tutorial.playerHand: This is your hand. Check the total point value of your cards.
tutorial.actionButtons: Choose Hit (draw a card) or Stand (keep your hand). The goal is to get close to 21.
tutorial.resultMessage: The game result is displayed here. Check the outcome and chips won or lost.
tutorial.resetButton: Press the reset button to start a new game.

hintReason.hitReason: Your total is low — hit recommended
hintReason.standReason: You have a good chance of winning — stand recommended
hintReason.declineReason: Insurance has negative expected value — decline recommended

payoutRef.title: Payouts
payoutRef.push: Tie (dealer wins; player wins only when both have natural blackjack)

doubleDownAvailable: Double down is available with two cards, enough chips for an additional bet, and DAS enabled after a split.

doubleDownUnavailable.cards: Double down is available only with two cards.
doubleDownUnavailable.chips: You do not have enough chips for the additional bet.
doubleDownUnavailable.split: Double down after a split is not allowed because DAS is disabled.
